meta.scope: Adversarial dispute on fr/en/ar i18n parity + encoding + placeholder integrity + cross-surface a11y coverage gaps
meta.method: static analysis (node + grep) + diff against UX/A11y findings

adversarial_findings.title: Arabic translation drops {n} placeholder — i18n interpolation will fail at runtime
adversarial_findings.evidence:
fr: 'Encore {n} portion : touchez une autre viande ou + sur une viande déjà choisie.' (HAS {n})
ar: 'بقيت حصة واحدة: المس لحماً آخر أو + على خيار اخترته.' (NO {n} — translator hardcoded 'one portion')
Result: vue-i18n $tc plural fallback may swallow or output {n} literal in mixed-RTL context.
adversarial_findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — restore {n} placeholder in ar translation: 'بقيت {n} حصة: ...' to keep interpolation contract. Add sentinel test placeholder-parity-fr-en-ar.
adversarial_findings.dispute_target: Confirms UX-P0-02 (fr→ar drift) with concrete behavioral break — not just orphan keys.

adversarial_findings.title: Empty-string keys inside fr.json under menu / label / kiosk.filters — emit dotted-suffix keys 'menu.', 'label.', 'kiosk.filters.'
adversarial_findings.evidence:
Line 260: menu."" = "Menu" (root menu node has empty child)
Line 629: label."" = "Libellé" (label namespace empty child)
Line 1432: kiosk.filters."" = "Tous" (filter namespace empty child)
These are NOT in en/ar — meaning $t('menu.') would crash or return raw 'menu.' string elsewhere.
adversarial_findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — rename to meaningful keys: menu.root, label.root (or whatever the use case is), kiosk.filters.all. Add sentinel test forbidding empty-string keys.
adversarial_findings.dispute_target: NEW finding — UX agent missed empty-string keys (treated 'menu.' as flatten bug; this verifies data-level bug).

adversarial_findings.title: Axe coverage gap is broader — mobile a11y wave (older artifact) ALSO missing recent goal-pageby capture
adversarial_findings.evidence: Only persisted artifacts: KDS goal-pageby (10 nodes) + mobile-design-perfect-wave-a11y from 2026-05-11 (253 nodes, 12 surfaces). NO axe for POS-12-pages, OSS, BORNE (Kiosk), STOCK, LIVREUR, WEB-23-pages of newer round. The 6-surface gap claim from UX is correct, but Mobile data is STALE (1 week old).
adversarial_findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — add axe-core/playwright integration to each goal-pageby-2026-05-18 surface spec AND re-run mobile-A11y with current build (since composition changes since 2026-05-11 may have introduced new violations).
adversarial_findings.dispute_target: Reinforces UX-P0-03 — also flags mobile axe staleness.

adversarial_findings.title: Arabic locale has 10 lines with NO Arabic characters — risk: stale-copy from fr
adversarial_findings.reproduction: node + filter ar values with length>3 and no /[Arabic Unicode range]/
adversarial_findings.evidence: Examples: label.siret='SIRET', label.paypal='Paypal', label.stripe='Stripe', kiosk.pay_screen.tr_sub='Edenred · Swile · Sodexo', kiosk.loyalty_screen.placeholder_phone='06 12 34 56 78'. Most are proper nouns or French phone format examples. Phone placeholder in Arabic locale should use Arabic-Indic digits or be localized.
adversarial_findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — owner review. Proper nouns OK (Stripe, Paypal, Edenred). Phone format example should use locale-appropriate. SIRET likely should stay (FR business ID).
adversarial_findings.dispute_target: Mostly false positives, but kiosk.loyalty_screen.placeholder_phone is a real i18n smell.

adversarial_findings.title: PHP lang catalog (Laravel) has only 16 files per locale — minimal coverage vs JSON catalog (~1900 keys each)
adversarial_findings.evidence: Laravel PHP catalog handles validation/auth/payment_gateway/pos_payment_method. Vue JSON catalog handles app UI. Two separate catalogs = double maintenance + drift surface. Existing audit tool (tools/i18n/audit_locale_keys.mjs) is aware of this dual-catalog model.
adversarial_findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — Not a bug per se. Document the split clearly + ensure i18nAuditTool spec covers PHP catalog drift too.
adversarial_findings.dispute_target: Architectural note for V1.0.X consolidation backlog.

adversarial_findings.title: Missing sentinel tests as promised by plan §9 — CrossSurfaceI18nLeakSentinelTest.php + I18nParityFrEnArSentinelTest.php do NOT exist
adversarial_findings.evidence: Plan §9 Sub 9.1 anchors test names 'tests/Feature/Sentinels/CrossSurfaceI18nLeakSentinelTest.php' and 'tests/Feature/Sentinels/I18nParityFrEnArSentinelTest.php' marked '(test TO BE CREATED)'. Existing sentinels only cover specific subsets: kdsAriaI18n (5-lang aria-label parity), studioFrontendI18nParity (studio.* namespace only), i18nForceFRForAdminSurfaces (helper assertion). No cross-namespace parity sentinel locks fr/en/ar coverage.
adversarial_findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — create i18nParityFrEnArSentinel.spec.js (vitest) that asserts fr/en/ar have identical flatKey sets minus declared-exception list. Will fail until parity drift is fixed — keeps drift from re-emerging.
adversarial_findings.dispute_target: Plan §9 acknowledged this as TO-BE-CREATED — RED confirms the gap is current.

adversarial_findings.title: No BOM detected, file encoding looks clean (UTF-8 no-BOM)
adversarial_findings.reproduction: first 3 bytes hex: 7b0a20 for all three files (= '{\n ', no BOM marker)
adversarial_findings.evidence: Files start with literal { followed by newline+space. No EF BB BF byte-order mark. Encoding is UTF-8 throughout (Arabic + French accented chars parse cleanly via JSON.parse without re-encoding).
adversarial_findings.dispute_target: Cleared encoding concern raised in scope.

adversarial_findings.title: Existing i18n audit tool present but NOT wired to CI / not run on goal-pageby cycle
adversarial_findings.reproduction: ls tools/i18n/ → audit_locale_keys.mjs (21KB, 9 mai 2026). tests/js/i18nAuditTool.spec.js exists with unit tests but no integration run output in reports/
adversarial_findings.evidence: audit_locale_keys.mjs has flattenJson, extractI18nKeysFromVue, extractI18nKeysFromBlade, diffMissing, parsePhpLocaleFile, resolveBladeKeyToPhp helpers. Spec covers helpers. NO E2E run that scans the whole codebase and emits a 'missing keys' report. Tool dormant since 9 mai.
adversarial_findings.recommendation: V1.0.X — write a `node tools/i18n/audit_locale_keys.mjs --emit-report reports/audit/i18n/` runner; integrate in CI as warn-only first then block.
adversarial_findings.dispute_target: Pre-existing infra not leveraged — could close P0-01/02 quickly when run.

agreement_with_ux_a11y: UX-P0-01 (fr/en parity drift) — CONFIRMED, with stronger framing (269 inconsistent keys not just '75 missing')
UX-P0-02 (fr/ar parity drift) — CONFIRMED, BUT escalated to P0 due to placeholder loss in ar (RED-P0-01)
UX-P0-03 (axe coverage gap) — CONFIRMED, EXTENDED to stale mobile data (RED-P1-03)
UX-P1-04/05 (KDS color-contrast + scrollable region) — CONFIRMED, no dispute
UX-P1-06/07/08 (mobile region/nested/button-name) — CONFIRMED, but mobile is standalone scope (Z-6); cross-zone risk noted
UX-P2-09/10 (stale-copy) — PARTIALLY DISPUTED — most are intentional proper nouns; only kiosk.pay_screen.tr_sub and admin.help.* warrant manual review
